1240100999555100672.a: Password reset sitting on the main boot menu with no security... I mean, you do have to take the box apart to get to it. I suppose you might as well give up at that point.

1240101707574542337.a: Factory reset switch is supposed to reset the entire system back to factory. This one kinda goes back to factory sorta but not everything. Like the mode it's in or the passwords. The ports clearly are working but it won't pass traffic. Like it's segmented into VLANs in hardware.

1240102588609179651.a: I would assume all passwords should go back to default printed on the cabinet (spoiler: default password printed on the cabinet is 'password') but there is something called "Debug Password" on the serial console that I have yet to figure out. Hardware passes full self test, also.
